title: Can’t share pet
text: If a simple function like my wife trying to share our dog’s account with me doesn’t work I have no hopes for the rest of this app.

title: Not what is advertised
text: This is NOT a free app and the pop up adds are inappropriate.

title: All AI slop
text: App is littered with AI generated images.

title: Clunky, Uses Gen AI slop
text:
I downloaded this as a medication tracker for my dog, and I found it very clunky to use. It also doesn’t allow for accurate tracking of when the medication is actually given.

Plus, this app is full of Gen AI slop. It made me want to immediately delete it, but there doesn’t seem to be a lot of competition for animal medication apps.

title: Portrait only
text: It works on the iPad but appears to only work in portrait mode, that was cumbersome to work with to fill out details and get started.  Might work once you have everything set up.  I really like that I didn’t have to register to try this out.

title: Review
text: So nice and easy, very dog friendly!

title: App logs me out
text: Every time I go to the calendar, the app logs me out. I kept the app for 5 minutes and then gave up…horrible.

title: I hope you like notifications
text:
This is a mess. You’ll try to set up simple reminders to give your pet their medication. You’ll end up getting literal “cat facts” notifications. You’ll get notifications about upcoming notifications (I wish I were joking). And then when you get the notification you really want, you head over to the app and there’s nothing there. No checkbox to confirm, no way to tell what’s supposed to happen. Your basic calendar and reminders app are 100 times better than this. Developer will probably say that I set it up wrong. Maybe, but I think setup should just take a few minutes and not be overly complicated. 

Today’s Cat Fact: Cats hate this app

title: CRASH A LOT!
text:
The app constantly closes…
